name: model-router
description: Classifies each prompt as simple, medium or complex and routes the turn to a cheaper or stronger model accordingly.

simpleModel.title: Simple model
simpleModel.description: Model for simple prompts (greetings, trivial edits, short questions).

mediumModel.title: Medium model
mediumModel.description: Model for medium prompts (one-file changes, small functions, clear debugging).

complexModel.title: Complex model
complexModel.description: Model for complex prompts. Empty keeps the session's own model.

classifierModel.title: Classifier model
classifierModel.description: Small model that classifies each prompt.
